title: Guide 7. How to Connect Payment Gateway to Process Payments | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Guide 7. How to Connect Payment Gateway to Process Payments Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000019819 This video will guide you through how to set up payment processing for your Brilliant Directories website. Some of the topics discussed in this video are: Payment Gateway options available to you Signing up for a free Stripe Account Linking your Stripe account to your website to be able to accept payments. Find more information about other payment gateways compatible with Brilliant Directories: Supported Payment Gateways For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
